summary.text: Shen Jie Ao, titled Proud Bone Demon Lord, is a rank eight demonic path Gu Immortal who created the White Bone Chariot and White Bone Battlefield killer moves.

claims.text: Fang Yuan stares at a damaged Battle Bone Wheel half sunk in his true gold primeval sea and notes that only bone bamboo Gu with ghost fire Gu can restore it. He links the Gu to Shen Jie Ao: when that cultivator became a rank six Gu Immortal and lacked a rank six Gu, he built White Bone Chariot from many rank five Gu such as the white bone wheel, with power comparable to a rank six Gu. That ingenuity carried him to rank eight, and White Bone Battlefield, a killer move combining three Immortal Gu, outstripped the earlier chariot. With it he dominated the world, killed an uncountable number of Gu Immortals, and left the righteous path helpless. Fang Yuan ranks him with Blood Sea Ancestor among figures that impress him.

White Bone Chariot is a Gu house. When he became a rank six Gu Immortal and lacked a rank six Gu, he created that killer move from many rank five Gu such as White Bone Wheel, with power comparable to a rank six Gu.

In the long history of Gu Masters, Fang Yuan knows only one mortal killer move with the offensive power of an Immortal Gu: White Bone Chariot from Proud Bone Demon Lord Shen Jie Ao, called a peerless creation standing high above in both ancient and present times. Fang Yuan ranks his own talent below Shen Jie Ao when weighing whether a mortal substitute can keep his myriad self killer move powerful without its Immortal Gu core.

In the long history of humanity, only one mortal killer move is publicly known to match Immortal Gu when activated: White Bone Chariot created by Proud Bone Demon Lord Shen Jie Ao. He was a rank eight demonic path Gu Immortal, proud for good reason; in this particular achievement, none of the ten venerables could match him.
